messages:
maria: Quick capacity check — vendor just said a US‑west quota bump MAY land tomorrow but didn't confirm amounts. We have a prod canary at 09:00 UTC that needs ~+8 A100s (40GB) for ~2h. Can we confirm fallback plan if quota doesn't land?

lucas: Can we borrow from eu-west demo pool? I see 4 spare A100-equivalent slots there. Cross-region will add latency but might be OK for canary.

arjun: Cross-region adds ~30-50ms per request on our traces for this model, p95 impact larger. Other option: spin smaller H100s in us-west if vendor can't deliver — need quick perf smoke.

sara: Procurement pinged vendor. Tentative ETA 24-36h and they said PO needs to be confirmed. Sent the invoice link to procurement slack thread: https://vendor/po/VG-4492

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor update: PO acknowledged, provisioning started. Current ETA ~18h (ref VG-4492). Will update if slot commits change.

maria: OK — immediate mitigation plan: 1) Route canary traffic to eu-west for the 2h window (lucas to open infra PR). 2) Add a fallback in the canary runbook to use a smaller quantized variant in case latency/regression is unacceptable. Tagging @oncall for alert tolerance.

lucas: On it. I'll open a terraform PR to carve a temporary pool and add a route flag `route=canary`. Will add a note in the runbook. PR shortly.

lucas: Terraform snippet I'll include in PR:
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "temp_eu_burst" {
  region   = "eu-west1"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  capacity = 4
  ttl      = "2h"
}
```

arjun: Ran a quick smoke with 4x h100 (eu-west) and a scaled-down model: p50 ~85ms, p95 ~240ms — acceptable for canary. Logged results to /ops/canary-results/5081234567.

maria: Great. lucas, add a single-line rollback snippet and a note to cancel the eu-west carve if vendor confirms quota. If vendor completes earlier, we cancel cross-region and revert routes. :thumbsup:

lucas: Will do. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8422 — includes runbook addition.

sara: Noted — I'll chase PO sig and update this thread when vendor confirms.

oncall: I'll relax the perf alert for the canary window and watch the dashboards. If p95 > 300ms we cut traffic.

maria: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. If vendor confirms earlier we'll cancel the carve. Action items: lucas PR + runbook, sara chase PO, arjun smoke results (done).
